title: Health, Disease & Healing
subtitle: A Unified Geometric, Thermodynamic & Topological Framework

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Health, Disease & Healing” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.caption: Figure 4.1 — Health, Disease & Healing.
blocks.explanation: Pathology is cast as topological corruption, thermodynamic divergence, or attractor trapping on the human manifold; healing restores the Non-Equilibrium Steady State and stabilizes the Markov blanket. Disease appears as topological fracture (trauma), attractor trapping (chronic/metabolic), or infectious invasion. Modern medicine acts by vector perturbation (pharmacology), topological reconstruction (surgery), and manifold maintenance (allied disciplines); AYUSH and global traditions act as macro-systemic constitutional regulators. Integrative medicine, mental health as internal-manifold distortion, and the RCT/EBM-versus-precision-medicine tension complete the picture.
blocks.tts: Health, disease, and healing as geometry: pathology is a corrupted manifold or attractor trap; healing restores the body's non-equilibrium steady state.
